edges.rationale: Identical gather-sort-scatter algorithm with stride changed from two to three; actual train/test leakage.
Rolling recurrence variants share a state-update algorithm. Prime Fibonacci also shares the primality subproblem, so union these groups transitively.
Trial division/primality reused directly or as a material subroutine; input wrappers and aggregation do not justify disjoint evaluation groups. Broad conservative grouping, not asserted equivalence.
Mirror equality is the core operation or an explicit subroutine; construction/counting/deletion variants conservatively stay together. HumanEval/10 even supplies an is_palindrome helper.
Bracket depth/balance scanning reused across grouping, depth, validation, concatenation and nesting. Conservative broader skill cluster.
Same stable list filtering skeleton with changed membership/prefix/type/sign predicates; broader than exact paraphrase.
Set/frequency operations with unique-count, intersection, character and duplicate wrappers. Conservative shared-skill cluster including the authored seed; preserve its early exposure split.
Alphabet shifts and case transforms overlap through the composite encode task. Keep the transitive component in one split.
General positional base conversion contains binary formatting as a special case; sentinel strings are cosmetic.
Pair/triple zero-sum search shares combination enumeration and predicate; arity changes complexity, so this is conservative dependence grouping.
Minimum pair distance used as boolean threshold versus argmin pair output.
Shared digit-to-word mapping and numeric sorting, with changed direction/filter wrapper.
Both sum initial category inventories, subtract outgoing quantities and add incoming stock; different arithmetic traces do not remove shared balance structure.
Same capacity-minus-occupancy structure across parking levels/lots; conservative regrouping despite direction and per-level differences.
Relative-age affine relations and time offsets; shared skill grouping, broader than identical equation.
Piecewise/differential hours-times-rate earnings; same wage accounting skill conservatively grouped.
Related group-size relations, ratio/difference and total-part reasoning; conservative grouping rather than exact equivalence.
Capacity/fraction-filled/remaining-volume balance, with intermediate dependency differences.
Resolve institution/team location then city-to-county-seat relation; changing source entities does not change the relation chain.
Compare album counts across two bands; original-member qualifier adds a constraint but shares the main retrieval/comparison template.
Compare two birth dates, selecting older or younger tennis player; entities and comparison direction differ.
Lookup county-level city classification for two entities; selection versus conjunction is a conservative template group.
Player-to-club lookup with club city constraint; same relation chain under different entities.
